name: India Post GDS
intro: The India Post GDS form asks for a photograph and a signature, each within a KB range.

notes: Plain white or light background; face filling 70–80% of the frame.
documents.label: Photograph

notes: Black or blue pen on white paper; no shadows or stray marks.
documents.label: Signature

source.label: Summary of India Post GDS 2026 image guidelines (coaching-site summary, check the notification)

faqs.q: What is the India Post GDS photo size?
faqs.a: A JPG between 30 KB and 100 KB, around 320 × 400 pixels, with a plain light background.

faqs.q: What is the India Post GDS signature size?
faqs.a: A JPG between 20 KB and 100 KB, around 300 × 120 pixels.
